name: pixel-everywhere
description: Application mobile communautaire du serveur Discord Pixel Difficult Drawer.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit && node --check server/start.mjs && node --check server/account-deletion.mjs && node --check electron/entry.cjs && node --check electron/bootstrap.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/startup-guard.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check web/simple-startup.js && node --check web/android-startup.js && node --check web/native-interaction-stability.js && node --check web/manual-update-mode.js && node --check web/offline-access.js && node --check web/server-settings-v2.js && node --check web/interaction-access-stability.js && node --check scripts/prepare-macos-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-platform-startup.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-interactions.mjs
scripts.mac:build: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-macos-bundle.mjs && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64
